title: Where each kind of information is best found, best place first
note: Read by the planning skill. Each entry names a kind of information, the pattern in a question that points to it, and the places to look in order. `keeps_original` marks a place that republishes the original record unchanged (a mirror or wire), so it counts nearly as a primary source; `primary` marks the originator itself. This is advice for the plan: every claim still needs a word-for-word quote from a page that was read. Order within `places` is the order to try.

types.label: Earnings releases, shareholder letters and presentations

wire services carry the release word for word
same release, same wording
the originator's own announcement

wire service; unchanged text, timestamp
leadership and board pages
8-K Item 5.02 reports a change of officer or director; the proxy statement lists directors and pay; Forms 3, 4 and 13D/G show holdings

types.label: Biomedical literature, trials and drug approvals

types.label: Official statistics and government records
types.route_when: \b(unemployment rate|inflation|cpi|gdp|census|population of|interest rate|federal reserve|bls|labor statistics|economic data|government data|statistics)\b

places.why: bls.gov, census.gov, bea.gov or the national equivalent publish the figure and its reference period
republishes official series unchanged, with the release date

types.label: What a company is, makes, charges or says about itself

places.why: pricing, product and about pages, as the company states them
for a public company, the annual report states founding, headcount and business in one dated place
